plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.

conservative.read: This plan aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leverage and diversifying away from concentrated tech.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 2%) to reduce risk.
Trim SPY to 25% to lower concentration.
Increase QQQI to 25% to balance with income.
Trim CRWD to 10% to reduce tech concentration.
Trim SMH to 5% to lower semiconductor exposure.
This plan seeks growth while managing risk by reducing leverage and concentration.
balanced.read: This plan targets approximately 2.5% monthly growth with a risk-first approach. It balances broad market exposure, income, and reduced concentration.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and free up capital.
Increase CRWD to 20% to double down on a strong performer.
Initiate a 5% position in SOXS, an inverse semiconductor ETF, to hedge.
Add GUSH and VST as conditional buys if they trigger their entry points.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by concentrating in strong performers and using leverage. Expect higher potential gains but also significantly larger drawdowns and amplified losses due to leverage and concentrated bets.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and increase cash.
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Trim QQQ to 10% to reduce broad index exposure.

income.read: This plan aims for approximately 1% monthly income through distributions, not capital appreciation. It prioritizes capital preservation and reliable cash flow over growth potential.
